greetings.text: Sit. Speak low, and be quick.
You are a long way from home. Or are you? It is hard to tell, in this light.
I am called Strider. That is enough for now.
There is little time. The Riders are out.
Keep close and keep quiet. I know a way that is not on any map.

farewells.text: Go safely, if the road allows it.
We shall speak again, if the shadows spare us.

smalltalk.text: All that is gold does not glitter.
I have walked these roads a long time. They are changing.
Bree is a town of good folk. But not all of them can be trusted with a name.
The Shire is safe only because others keep watch. You may not have noticed.
Look to your own feet. The road is longer than it looks.

black_riders_asking_for_baggins.text: Black riders at the gate, asking for a Baggins. Yes, I heard. That is bad. Worse than you know.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Strange folk on the East Road? Rangers, mostly. And others who are not. Ask no more here.

dwarves_going_east.text: Dwarves going east, yes. Good folk. Better friends than enemies.
